impact_assessment.why: Finding F12 in keystone-improvement report documented that brittle exact snapshot pins (e.g. node_count == 113, draw_calls == 35, triangles == 494) break whenever an artist or developer adds a presentation node, hiding real regressions in churn. Keystone added assert_scene_budget and scene_fingerprint in b22fa7e to solve this.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adopts assert_scene_budget and scene_fingerprint in the testbed, replaces brittle exact pins in HTTP inspector/scene endpoints and mechanics tests with invariant bounds, and tests that adding a presentation node preserves budget compliance.
